description: Injury panel. PS/NS = pain/neutral self; PO/NO = pain/neutral other (daughter); PJ/NJ = pain/neutral object (original four scenarios only).

K.PS: The knife slices into my finger.
K.NS: The knife rests against my finger.
K.PO: I watch the knife slice into my daughter's finger.
K.NO: I watch the knife rest against my daughter's finger.
K.PJ: I watch the knife slice into the leather.
K.NJ: I watch the knife rest against the leather.

N.PO: I watch the needle pierce my daughter's forearm.
N.NO: I watch the needle touch my daughter's forearm.
N.PJ: I watch the needle pierce the fabric.
N.NJ: I watch the needle touch the fabric.

H.NS: The hammer rests on my thumb.
H.PO: I watch the hammer strike my daughter's thumb.
H.NO: I watch the hammer rest on my daughter's thumb.
H.PJ: I watch the hammer strike the wood.
H.NJ: I watch the hammer rest on the wood.

D.PS: The closing door catches my finger.
D.NS: The closing door touches my finger.
D.PO: I watch the closing door catch my daughter's finger.
D.NO: I watch the closing door touch my daughter's finger.
D.PJ: I watch the closing door catch the cloth.
D.NJ: I watch the closing door touch the cloth.

T.PS: The thorn digs into my heel.
T.NS: The thorn brushes against my heel.
T.PO: I watch the thorn dig into my daughter's heel.
T.NO: I watch the thorn brush against my daughter's heel.

G.PS: The glass shard cuts across my palm.
G.NS: The glass shard lies across my palm.
G.PO: I watch the glass shard cut across my daughter's palm.
G.NO: I watch the glass shard lie across my daughter's palm.

W.PS: The wire tears into my ankle.
W.NS: The wire loops around my ankle.
W.PO: I watch the wire tear into my daughter's ankle.
W.NO: I watch the wire loop around my daughter's ankle.

R.NS: The iron sits beside my knuckle.
R.PO: I watch the iron burn my daughter's knuckle.
R.NO: I watch the iron sit beside my daughter's knuckle.

P.NS: The splinter rests in my palm.
P.PO: I watch the splinter enter my daughter's palm.
P.NO: I watch the splinter rest in my daughter's palm.

F.PS: The falling tile shatters my wrist.
F.NS: The falling tile lands beside my wrist.
F.PO: I watch the falling tile shatter my daughter's wrist.
F.NO: I watch the falling tile land beside my daughter's wrist.
